name: mention-monorepo
description: Monorepo for @danielivanov/mention and its docs site. The library lives in packages/react; the Fumadocs docs site lives in apps/docs.

scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && cd packages/react && bun run test:e2e
scripts.type-check: bun run build && cd packages/react && bun run type-check && cd ../../apps/docs && bun run types:check
scripts.docs:build: bun run build && cd apps/docs && bun run build
